result.title: Coding Assessment: Compute Square of a Single Integer

problems.title: Compute Square of a Single Integer
problems.description: Write a program that reads a single integer from standard input and prints its square. The input will contain exactly one integer N. Output the value N*N on a single line.
problems.inputFormat: A single line containing an integer N.
problems.outputFormat: A single line containing the square of N.
problems.explanation: 5 squared is 25, so the program outputs 25.
